scanner.title: Set up scanner
scanner.subtitle: These permissions allow the Strive bubble to appear over VTC apps and scan the screen.
scanner.disclosureBody: Strive uses the accessibility service and screen capture ONLY to analyze offers shown in Uber, Bolt, and Heetch via on-device OCR, each time you tap the scan button. No personal data is read or collected. Analysis runs locally on your device.
scanner.overlayDesc: Settings → Apps → Special access → Display over other apps → Strive → Enable

scanner.infoText: Come back here after each step and tap Refresh to update the status.
scanner.iosSubtitle: Set up a shortcut once — then double-tap the back of your iPhone to analyze any offer from Uber, Bolt or Heetch.
scanner.iosStep1Desc: In Shortcuts: "Take screenshot" then "Analyze a ride with Strive".
scanner.iosStep2Desc: Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Back Tap → Double Tap: pick your shortcut.
scanner.iosStep3Desc: From Uber/Bolt/Heetch, double-tap the back of your iPhone. The verdict appears live in the Dynamic Island.
scanner.iosInfoText: Analysis runs locally on your iPhone (Vision + Gemini fallback). No personal data is collected.

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Questions & Answers
help.contactDesc: A question not covered here? Write to us — we reply within 24h.

faq.a1: The scanner captures your VTC app's screen via the accessibility service, extracts trip details (fare, distance, duration) using OCR, and shows you a verdict based on your minimum rates.
faq.a2: Uber, Bolt and Heetch are currently supported. More platforms are coming soon.
faq.a3: Make sure both permissions are granted in the scanner setup screen: "Display over other apps" and "Accessibility service" must both be enabled.
faq.q4: How do I change my minimum rates?
faq.a4: Go to Profile → Trip Preferences. Adjust the sliders for hourly rate and per-km rate. Changes apply immediately.
faq.q5: How do I cancel my Plus subscription?
faq.a5: On Android: Google Play → Subscriptions. On iOS: Settings → Your name → Subscriptions. Find Strive and tap Cancel.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.q1: How does the 3-day free trial work?
faq.a1: The first 3 days are 100% free. Cancel anytime from iOS Settings before the trial ends and you won't be charged. Otherwise, the subscription auto-renews at the regular price.
faq.a2: Yes. 1 tap from iOS Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. No questions, no friction, no commitment.
faq.q3: What ride apps does Strive support?
faq.a3: Uber, Bolt, Heetch and any rideshare app that shows the ride offer on screen. Strive scans any screenshot to extract the price, distance and time.
faq.a4: Everything is encrypted and stored securely. No data sold, no ads, no third-party tracking. You can delete your account anytime from the app.
